MEASURED at --std 2002: probe p4_gr18_null (`>>TURN EC-DATA-PTR-NULL CHECKING ON`, `SET P TO NULL.` then `SET P UP BY 4.`) terminates with `abnormal run-unit termination: EC-DATA-PTR-NULL (fatal): SET pointer UP/DOWN BY with a NULL pointer operand (ISO 14.9.39 Format 10 GR18)`; probe p4_gr18_null_nocheck, the same program without the TURN, prints AFTER-UP and leaves the operand at NULL — the §14.6.13 checking-off behaviour, and the value returned is the unchanged operand rather than an invented address.
